steps.text: The Triangle Tower (south-east of Thais) is not on the 7.1 map. If the tower is closed, pull the lever in the desert east of it to open the wall (7.2 map: 32573,32121,7).
steps.source: If the tower is closed you will have to go into the desert and pull the lever to open the wall, the lever is found here (Mapper Coords 127.62, 125.122, 7).

steps.text: Go into the Triangle Tower and up to the top floor: skeletons, ghouls, demon skeletons, stalkers (7.2 map: last stairs 32564,32117,4).
steps.source: First, head to the Triangle Tower, which is found here (Mapper Coords 127.49, 125.119, 7), and go up to the top.

steps.text: On the top floor (a monk, a witch and a dwarf geomancer), the chest: a dwarven ring, 2 small sapphires and a garlic necklace in a bag (7.2 map: 32565,32119,3).
steps.source: After reaching the fourth floor and eventually killing everything there, open the box to get your reward.
